title: Fraction Calculator
description:
```
Enter fraction 1: 3/4
Enter fraction 2: 5/6
Sum:      19/12  (1 7/12)
Diff:     -1/12
Product:  5/8
Quotient: 9/10
Decimal of sum: 1.58333
```
hints: Reading `3/4` is three reads in a row: `std::cin >> f.num >> slash >> f.den;` with `char slash{};`.
Dividing by a fraction is multiplying by it upside down: `a / b` is `a * Fraction{ b.den, b.num }`.
The mixed number for 19/12 is the whole part `19 / 12` (1) and the remainder `19 % 12` (7) over 12.
requirements: `int gcd(int a, int b)` (Euclid's algorithm), `void reduce(Fraction&)`
Reject zero denominators; keep the sign on the numerator
